title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: Bookings on Which an Approval Carries Its Administration Fee
content:
## Clause

Whenever a Dangerous Goods Acceptance file under review is approved, its administration fee is booked in that same act, as a single administration-fee entry dated on the approval date. The fee arises for goods whose acceptance is under review and whose booking is recorded as a dangerous-goods booking with a status of requested, confirmed or equipment released; no other booking can receive an approval at all. For goods on any other booking the administration fee is 0.00.

## Condition grid

| Acceptance status | Booking cargo type | Booking status | Administration fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| under review | dangerous goods | requested, confirmed or equipment released | the category's fee |
| under review | dangerous goods | gated in, loaded, departed, closed or cancelled | 0.00 |
| under review | any other cargo type | any | 0.00 |
| any status other than under review | any | any | 0.00 |

## Point of judgement

**Where does the date of the administration-fee entry come from?** It is the approval date: the fee is booked in the act of approving.
